name: List Meetings
description: List meetings for a user. [See the documentation](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/zoom-api/methods/#operation/meetings)

configurable_props.name: userId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: The user ID or email address of the user to list meetings for

configurable_props.name: type
configurable_props.label: Type
configurable_props.description: The type of meetings to list. Defaults to `scheduled`

options.label: All valid previous (unexpired) meetings, live meetings, and upcoming scheduled meetings
All upcoming meetings, including live meetings

configurable_props.name: from
configurable_props.label: From
configurable_props.description: The start date and time of the meetings to list. Example: `2023-01-01`

configurable_props.name: to
configurable_props.label: To
configurable_props.description: The end date and time of the meetings to list. Example: `2023-01-01`

configurable_props.name: timezone
configurable_props.label: Timezone
configurable_props.description: The timezone to use for the `from` and `to` dates. Example: `America/New_York`

configurable_props.name: titleSearch
configurable_props.label: Title Search
configurable_props.description: The title of the meetings to search for

configurable_props.name: createdAfter
configurable_props.label: Created After
configurable_props.description: The date and time to filter meetings created after. Example: `2023-01-01`

configurable_props.name: createdBefore
configurable_props.label: Created Before
configurable_props.description: The date and time to filter meetings created before. Example: `2023-01-01`

configurable_props.name: max
configurable_props.label: Max Resources
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of resources to retrieve.
